titleEn: First Day Where You Have Been in All the Rooms
title: 访问完所有房间的第一天
summary: 按房间访问次数奇偶决定下一房间：奇数次去 nextVisit[i]，偶数次去 i+1，求首次访问全部房间的天数。
insight: 令 dp[i] 为首次到达房间 i 的天数。首次到达 i-1 后还要回到 nextVisit[i-1]，再重走到 i-1 并向前，因此 dp[i]=2dp[i-1]-dp[next]+2。
pitfalls: 结果取模且减法需修正为非负
答案是天数而非访问次数

solutions.title: 首次到达日递推
solutions.idea: 用此前首次到达日计算一次回访循环长度。

code.java: class Solution { public int firstDayBeenInAllRooms(int[] nextVisit){long[] dp=new long[nextVisit.length];for(int i=1;i<dp.length;i++)dp[i]=(2*dp[i-1]-dp[nextVisit[i-1]]+2+1_000_000_007)%1_000_000_007;return (int)dp[dp.length-1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun firstDayBeenInAllRooms(nextVisit:IntArray):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007L;val dp=LongArray(nextVisit.size);for(i in 1 until dp.size)dp[i]=(2*dp[i-1]-dp[nextVisit[i-1]]+2+mod)%mod;return dp.last().toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int firstDayBeenInAllRooms(vector<int>& nextVisit){const long long MOD=1000000007;vector<long long> dp(nextVisit.size());for(int i=1;i<(int)dp.size();++i)dp[i]=(2*dp[i-1]-dp[nextVisit[i-1]]+2+MOD)%MOD;return dp.back();} };
